Help centre

Frequently asked.

Clear answers about this storefront, product information and the current order-request model.

Can I check out online?

The bag works locally, but payment and fulfilment are not connected. A customer can save selections and request a checkout link once the business connects a verified commerce service.

Are the products medical treatments?

No. Product descriptions cover ingredients, formats and practical directions. They do not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.

How should I choose a supplement?

Read the complete final label and speak with a qualified professional if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or managing a health condition.

Why are no certificates shown?

No client-supplied certification records were available for verification. The quality page explains what must be supplied before any badge or claim is published.

Does the consultation form send my details?

Not yet. It demonstrates the intended request flow but does not transmit or store personal information until a secure backend is connected.

Where is the physical store?

A permanent address has not been verified for publication, so this site does not show a map or invented location.
